statements.statement: CPT 93229 mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered for the patient
The patient presented with intermittent palpitations and a sensation of irregular heartbeat
The patient has known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
The diagnosis codes are R00.2 and I34.0
The denial reason code is CO-197
The authorization was not obtained prior to the service
Continuous rhythm monitoring during daily activities was medically necessary to correlate the patient's symptoms with any underlying cardiac conduction abnormalities
